title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
source: reel> cass > cass Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with some audible cuts yet still clear enough to capture a legendary 1970 show highlighted by Cryptical Envelopment, Cosmic Charlie and the magical acoustic set.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this performance as possibly the finest of 1970, especially praising the Cryptical Envelopment → Cosmic Charlie sequence and the intimate acoustic portion.  The soundboard recording is listenable but contains noticeable edits and occasional drop‑outs that a few reviewers flagged.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic comments about the musical performance (70% weight) combined with moderate recording issues (30% weight) lead to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note cuts, sound issues and occasional monitor problems, but the mix remains generally listenable and retains the show’s energy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Electric sets are described as amazing while the acoustic set is called essential, giving the concert a dynamic rise‑and‑fall that many fans find unforgettable.
